summary_1line: Angada and the monkey warriors battle several rakshasa champions until Kumbha devastates them, leading Sugriva to confront him in a fierce duel.

image_candidates.scene_text: Angada, bleeding and half‑blinded, hurls a massive Sala tree at the archer Kumbha while arrows rain through the battlefield.
Kumbha stands radiant like Indra, drawing his bow to his ear as golden‑feathered arrows streak toward the monkey warriors.
Sugriva and Kumbha grapple like two enraged elephants, their bodies locked as the earth trembles beneath their feet.
